summary: Bennett Foddy's Getting Over It is a deliberately punishing physics climbing game, currently available on PC and mobile with input feel and timing as core archive variables.

entries.title: Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with mouse/input settings documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with input/framerate state documented

primary.why: The PC release is the definitive capture route because mouse input, framerate, and physics feel are central to Getting Over It. Mobile ports are important accessibility routes but change input feel substantially.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release with a mouse. Record build, input device/sensitivity, resolution/framerate, save/progress state, timer/speedrun state, commentary/audio, and whether mobile touch controls were compared.

secondary.why: Touch input changes the game's feel and is not the primary PC archive route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Mouse and touch routes have substantially different input feel.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record framerate, sensitivity, and save/progress state.
